eligibility: Adults 18+ (21+ to drive) able to lift 125 lbs solo, with a smartphone; drivers need a 2001-or-newer vehicle plus license/insurance/registration; helpers need no vehicle.
notes: Scenario: on-demand moving/delivery. Lugg connects people needing a truck with Luggers: drivers use their own truck/van, helpers can join with no vehicle. Jobs pay hourly averages with tips (Lugg never takes a cut of tips) and same-day pay. No CDL required. Earnings vary by market, effort, vehicle, and demand — variable, never guaranteed.
